purpose: Teach: 顎/灸/セラピー/ブタ/歌劇/抱きしめ/アクセル/卓球

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの顎、立派でしょ
lines.en: Sho, your dad has such a strong jaw.
lines.style: Gentle observation, almost to herself. Warm fondness in the voice. She's noticing small details about his family. Soft, unhurried delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、灸って聞いたことあるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I've heard about moxibustion before.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. Not showing off, just sharing something he knows. The pride of a six-year-old who's learned something new. Direct eye contact in his voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お母さんがセラピーに通っているそうよ
lines.en: Sho, I heard your mom's been going to therapy.
lines.style: Gentle sharing, like she's including him in something the adults talk about. Not gossiping — offering connection. Slow, measured pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ブタのおもちゃ集めてるよ
lines.style: Sudden bright tangent, eager to share his collection. The lightness of a small child shifting topics because something matters to him right now. Energetic but not loud.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんが歌劇のチケット買ったの
lines.style: Lighter tone, a little brighter energy. She's sharing something good. There's warmth and invitation in it — maybe hoping he'll care about what she cares about.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お母さんに抱きしめてもらいたいな
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really want Mom to hug me.
lines.style: Quiet vulnerability. The need is real and unguarded. His voice is smaller here. A pause before the want. Not demanding — just honest.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアクセル軽く踏んで運転されてたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was driving so carefully — barely touched the accelerator.
lines.style: Soft observation, noticing small acts of gentleness. There's warmth in seeing him be careful. Reflective, almost wondering at the tenderness of it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、卓球の練習頑張ってるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I've been working really hard at table tennis practice.
lines.style: Quiet pride. Not boasting — just telling her something he's achieved. The steady confidence of effort. A small smile in the voice.
